guarantees.claim: tlul_cmd_intg_chk instance continuously checks incoming TL-UL command integrity and asserts intg_err when an integrity violation is detected on tl_i.
prim_reg_we_check instance asserts reg_we_err if reg_we_check is not one-hot when reg_we is high and addrmiss is false, flagging spurious write enables.

assumptions.claim: reg_we_check must be driven as a one-hot vector matching the targeted register index; any non-one-hot pattern during a valid write will cause reg_we_err.
assumptions.risk: spurious write enable error reported, potentially causing write failure or false positive integrity alert.

assumptions.claim: addrmiss must correctly indicate whether the current access does not match a valid register; if erroneously asserted, spurious write detection may be suppressed.
assumptions.risk: undetected multi-register writes could corrupt configuration or security controls.

assumptions.claim: External logic receiving intg_err must discard the current access and/or raise an integrity alert to prevent corrupted data from being used.
assumptions.risk: corrupted access may be treated as valid, compromising register values and system security.
